1: // Simple "Cosmic Dodge" game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
8:   // Audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   }
23:   function playSpawnSound(){ playTone(400, 0.05); }
24:   function playCollisionSound(){ playTone(150, 0.4); }
25:   function resize() {
26:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
27:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
28:     ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
29:     // regenerate stars for new size
30:     generateStars(200);
31:     // update player gradient to match new size
32:     createPlayerGradient();
33:   }
34: 
35:   // Star field data
36:   const stars = [];
37:   function generateStars(count) {
38:     stars.length = 0;
39:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
40:       stars.push({
41:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width / dpr,
42:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height / dpr,
43:         // brightness will fluctuate each frame
44:         brightness: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
45:       });
46:     }
47:   }
48:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
49:   resize();
50: 
51:   // Player (triangle) definition
52:   const player = {
53:     x: 80,
54:     y: canvas.height / (dpr * 2),
55:     size: 20,
56:     speed: 300, // pixels per second
57:     // Use a cyan gradient for a futuristic look
58:     color: null,
59:   };
60:   // Create player gradient once (will be updated on resize)
61:   function createPlayerGradient(){
62:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y - player.size/2, 0, player.y + player.size/2);
63:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
64:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#00f');
65:     player.color = grad;
66:   }
67: 
68: 
69:   const keys = new Set();
70:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys.add(e.key));
71:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys.delete(e.key));
72:   // Ensure audio context runs after user interaction
73:   window.addEventListener('click', () => audioCtx.resume());
74:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => audioCtx.resume());
75: 
76:   // Asteroid pool
77:   const asteroids = [];
78:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
79:   let lastSpawn = 0;
80: 
81:   function spawnAsteroid() {
82:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
83:     asteroids.push({
84:       x: canvas.width / dpr + radius,
85:       y: Math.random() * (canvas.height / dpr),
86:       r: radius,
87:       speed: 100 + Math.random() * 150,
88:     });
89:     playSpawnSound();
90:   }
91: 
92:   let lastTime = performance.now();
93:   let score = 0;
94: 
95:   function update(dt) {
96:     // Player movement
97:     const moveDist = player.speed * dt;
98:     if (keys.has('ArrowUp') || keys.has('w')) player.y -= moveDist;
99:     if (keys.has('ArrowDown') || keys.has('s')) player.y += moveDist;
100:     if (keys.has('ArrowLeft') || keys.has('a')) player.x -= moveDist;
101:     if (keys.has('ArrowRight') || keys.has('d')) player.x += moveDist;
102:     // Keep inside canvas
103:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.x, canvas.width / dpr));
104:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(player.y, canvas.height / dpr));
105: 
106:     // Asteroid movement & spawn
107:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.x -= a.speed * dt);
108:     // Remove off‑screen
109:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
110:       if (asteroids[i].x + asteroids[i].r < 0) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
111:     }
112:     // Spawn new
113:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
114:       spawnAsteroid();
115:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Collision detection (simple circle‑point check)
119:     for (const a of asteroids) {
120:       const dx = a.x - player.x;
121:       const dy = a.y - player.y;
122:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
123:       if (dist < a.r + player.size / 2) {
124:         // Game over – stop animation
125:         playCollisionSound();
126:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score));
127:         // Reset state
128:         asteroids.length = 0;
129:         player.x = 80;
130:         player.y = canvas.height / (dpr * 2);
131:         score = 0;
132:         break;
133:       }
134:     }
135: 
136:     // Scoring
137:     score += dt * 10; // 10 points per second
138:   }
139: 
140:   function draw() {
141:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width / dpr, canvas.height / dpr);
142: 
143:     // Enhanced background with gradient and twinkling stars
144:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height / dpr);
145:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
146:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
147:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
148:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width / dpr, canvas.height / dpr);
149:     // Update and draw stars with twinkle effect
150:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
151:     for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
152:       const s = stars[i];
153:       // Slightly vary brightness each frame
154:       s.brightness = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
155:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.brightness;
156:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
157:     }
158:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
159: 
160:     // Draw player triangle with gradient fill
161:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
162:     ctx.beginPath();
163:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size / 2);
164:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
165:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
166:     ctx.closePath();
167:     ctx.fill();
168: 
169:     // Draw asteroids with subtle radial gradient
170:     for (const a of asteroids) {
171:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
172:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
173:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
174:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:       ctx.fill();
178:     }
179: 
180:     // Score overlay
181:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
182:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
183:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
184:   }
185: 
186:   function loop() {
187:     const now = performance.now();
188:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
189:     lastTime = now;
190:     update(dt);
191:     draw();
192:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193:   }
194:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195: })();
